note: The 17 HVAC pricing categories (Build slice HV-3; was 16 at HV-1). HV-3 added hvac_raceway as a category of its own on an OWNER RULING: cable trays / raceways are a separately-priced package, so hvac_cables narrows to cabling only (cables/wiring) and the tray vocabulary moves out of it. Original HV-1 note follows. The 16 HVAC pricing categories (Build slice HV-1). Same shape + contract as categories_electrical.json: category_id is stable, name is the human/AI display label (must match the team labelling legend Categories_Legend.csv), description is the human/AI reference. ABSTAIN returns a BLANK category_id ('') via scoring.novel_category_id (shared scoring.json). The engine stays DISABLED in engines.py until the ruleset is tuned + prompt certified + HVAC routing locked (registry flip is a separate gated slice).

categories.name: Ducting
categories.description: GI/GSS/spiral/oval/round sheet-metal ductwork, gauge-based fabrication + installation (incl. PIR pre-insulated and fire-rated duct).

categories.name: ADP
categories.description: Air Distribution Products: grilles, diffusers, dampers (incl. fire dampers), VCDs, spigots, collars, plenums, trap doors, canvas connections.

categories.name: Piping
categories.description: All HVAC piping: chilled water, condenser water, refrigerant (copper), and drain (CPVC/uPVC/MS/GI).

categories.name: Insulation
categories.description: Duct/pipe thermal + acoustic insulation: nitrile, elastomeric, fiberglass, glasswool, aluminium cladding, acoustic lining.

categories.name: Valve Package
categories.description: Valves and valve assemblies: butterfly, NRV, sluice, globe, balancing, PICV, strainers, rising spindle.

categories.name: VAV Box
categories.description: VAV/CAV terminal boxes, CFM-rated air terminals.

categories.name: Sensors & Controls
categories.description: Sensors, transmitters, gauges, thermostats, BMS/BACnet controllers and integration items.

categories.name: Fans
categories.description: Ventilation/exhaust/axial/inline fans, kitchen exhaust, scrubbers, make-up air units.

categories.name: CHW Units
categories.description: Chilled-water terminal units: ductable, cassette, hi-wall, FCU.

categories.name: DX Unit
categories.description: Direct-expansion splits: hi-wall, cassette, ductable (non-VRF refrigerant).

categories.name: VRF
categories.description: VRF/VRV systems: ODU, IDU, refnet/Y-joints and VRF ancillaries (refrigerant gas topping, ODU stands).

categories.name: Cables
categories.description: HVAC power/control cabling and wiring only (owns VRF control cabling). Cable trays / raceways are hvac_raceway (HV-3 owner ruling).

categories.name: Raceway
categories.description: cable trays, raceways, and tray accessories

categories.name: AHU
categories.description: Air handling units, TFA units, cooling coils, AHU accessories.

categories.name: Panels
categories.description: Starter panels, control panels, VFD panels for HVAC equipment (NOT double-skin AHU/plenum casing panels).

categories.name: Misc
categories.description: Genuine HVAC lines fitting no other category: T&B/commissioning services, water treatment, vibration isolators, dismantling/recommissioning, misc hardware.
